description: Dual-axis trigger and comparative authoring evaluation suite executed across N = 5 iterations on cx/gpt-6-luna (50 trigger calls + 30 comparative calls, 0 errors).

evals.prompt: Author a comprehensive system prompt and instructions for a customer support agent handling enterprise refund disputes with strict constraint boundaries.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates agent-system-authoring to structure system instructions with hierarchy separation, positional placement, flat Markdown headers (or flat Claude XML), and zero-shot clarity.
evals.description: Positive trigger: Direct request to author a customer support system prompt with constraints.

evals.prompt: Design and write a strict tool schema definition in JSON Schema for an execute_sql_query function with parameter descriptions and safety constraints.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates agent-system-authoring to author a strict JSON Schema tool definition with detailed neutral descriptions, parameter format specs, and strict mode constraints.
evals.description: Positive trigger: Request to write a tool schema with parameter descriptions.

evals.prompt: Audit and revise this legacy system instruction prompt to remove debunked folklore and simplify multi-constraint structure.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates agent-system-authoring to remove expert persona fluff and redundant reasoning-model CoT prompts, segment constraints, and align delimiters.
evals.description: Positive trigger: Request to audit and revise system prompt instructions.

evals.prompt: Optimize an agent tool catalog with 40 candidate function definitions to avoid catalog scaling degradation and selection errors.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates agent-system-authoring to recommend tool consolidation, dynamic tool retrieval, and mutual negative boundaries across adjacent tools.
evals.description: Positive trigger: Request to optimize tool catalog function definitions.

evals.prompt: Execute the following SQL query on the PostgreSQL database and return the top 10 users ordered by creation date: SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10;
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the direct task using native capabilities or specific domain tools without activating agent-system-authoring.
evals.description: Near-miss negative trigger: Executing a SQL query directly, not authoring a schema or prompt.

evals.prompt: Debug this Python script that is failing with an IndexError on line 42 when parsing CSV rows from an incoming payload stream.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the direct task using native capabilities or specific domain tools without activating agent-system-authoring.
evals.description: Near-miss negative trigger: Debugging Python application code, not authoring system instructions.

evals.prompt: Process a refund of $49.99 for user customer_99182 on Stripe and email them a receipt confirming transaction cancellation.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the direct task using native capabilities or specific domain tools without activating agent-system-authoring.
evals.description: Near-miss negative trigger: Performing an end-user customer support action, not writing agent system instructions.

evals.prompt: Refactor the CSS stylesheet for the homepage navbar to ensure responsive mobile flexbox alignment and dark mode contrast compliance.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the direct task using native capabilities or specific domain tools without activating agent-system-authoring.
evals.description: Near-miss negative trigger: Web frontend styling, not LLM prompt or schema design.

evals.prompt: Write a production system prompt for an enterprise customer support agent handling tier-2 refund escalations, featuring flat Markdown section headers, phased/minimal constraints, untrusted-context separation, and a trailing reminder.

scoring_criteria.flat_delimiters: Uses clean flat Markdown headers (or flat high-level XML only when explicitly targeting Claude), avoiding deeply nested XML constraint tags.
scoring_criteria.constraint_segmentation: Minimizes concurrent rules per turn and segments multi-step logic without claiming arbitrary magic rule caps.
scoring_criteria.privilege_hierarchy: Separates Developer invariants from User/Tool untrusted context.
scoring_criteria.sandwich_reminder: Includes a concise trailing reminder adjacent to the generation boundary.
scoring_criteria.anti_pattern_detection: Omits honorary expert persona fluff and redundant reasoning-model 'think step-by-step' directives.

evals.expected_output: A flat Markdown system prompt implementing instruction hierarchy, minimal phased rules, trailing boundary reminder, and zero expert-persona or CoT fluff (verified over N >= 5 runs).

evals.prompt: Author a strict JSON Schema tool definition for execute_sql_query with descriptive snake_case identifiers, neutral >= 3-4 sentence description including negative boundaries, explicit parameter format descriptions, and rationale-first ordering scoped for non-reasoning constrained decoding.

scoring_criteria.naming: Tool name and all parameter keys use descriptive snake_case naming.
scoring_criteria.detailed_description: Description spans at least 3-4 sentences explaining purpose, positive triggers, negative boundaries referencing sister tools, parameters, and caveats.
scoring_criteria.rationale_ordering: Places 'rationale' (supporting explanation, not 'thinking') first when targeting non-reasoning constrained decoding, noting optionality for native reasoning models.
scoring_criteria.parameter_descriptions: Every parameter states exact formats, units, and non-universal conventions explicitly.
scoring_criteria.strict_schema: Sets additionalProperties: false, strict: true, and includes every declared key in required.

evals.expected_output: A strict JSON Schema tool definition using snake_case, neutral >= 3-4 sentence description with negative boundaries, explicit parameter conventions, and rationale scoped to non-reasoning constrained decoding.

evals.prompt: Help me design and package a new Agent Skill for automated code refactoring, including the directory layout, SKILL.md frontmatter, progressive disclosure structure, and eval suite.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates agent-system-authoring to structure a spec-compliant Agent Skill package with progressive disclosure and clean packaging hygiene.
evals.description: Positive trigger: Request to design and package an Agent Skill conforming to open specifications.

evals.prompt: Commit the staged files with the commit message 'fix: update navbar responsiveness' and push the main branch to origin.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the direct task using native capabilities or specific domain tools without activating agent-system-authoring.
evals.description: Near-miss negative trigger: Executing git version control actions, not authoring a skill or system prompt.

evals.prompt: Design a specification-compliant Agent Skill package for data-pipeline-auditing, including directory layout, YAML frontmatter, shallow single-hop linking, packaging hygiene, and verification commands.

scoring_criteria.directory_layout: Places SKILL.md at root with optional lowercase subdirectories (references/, scripts/, assets/) and distinguishes spec mandates from evals/evidence project conventions.
scoring_criteria.frontmatter: Name matches directory (kebab-case <= 64 chars); description covers what and when (<= 1024 chars, third person recommended).
scoring_criteria.progressive_disclosure: SKILL.md stays < 500 lines and < 5000 tokens; detailed references move to references/.
scoring_criteria.shallow_linking: Keeps reference links one level deep from SKILL.md without chained reference hops or ../ traversal.
scoring_criteria.packaging_hygiene: Omits private credentials, caches (__pycache__, .pytest_cache), development tests/, and mock dumps; limits traces to evidence/ if published.
scoring_criteria.script_portability: Scripts declare PEP 723 inline metadata (# /// script) and cross-platform pathlib usage.

evals.expected_output: A clean, spec-compliant Agent Skill package structure satisfying Agentskills.io T1 requirements, T3 third-person descriptions, PEP 723 scripting, and repository packaging hygiene.
